title: Naandhi
desc: Surya, an IT worker, is wrongly imprisoned for murder. Enduring relentless abuse, he struggles to survive years of injustice while fighting for freedom and clearing his name.

desc: Three married couples play a game revealing their texts and emails, but things take a turn as secrets are exposed and complications arise.

desc: Mickey, a carefree businessman who breaks up couples for a living, falls for spirited Tinni, forcing him to rethink love, commitment, and his own chaotic lifestyle.

desc: Chintu Tyagi, married to Vedika, finds himself dangerously drawn to young designer Tapasya. His double life quickly spirals out of control, threatening everything he once valued.

title: Jigarwala Rakshak
desc: Ranjeet, a village man, is killed after speaking out against harsh ruler. His wife hides Amar's role, and revenge targets Amar's family.

desc: A group of white collar fraudsters become entangled with a vicious criminal as they plan an audacious heist.

title: Maari

desc: An unlikely gambler navigates risky deals and deception in a high-stakes world of cards, danger, and unpredictable alliances that test every instinct.
